# Kerr Electrical Services

> Your local, experienced electrician for homes and small businesses in Lenzie, Kirkintilloch and the surrounding areas. Family-run, over 35 years of experience, free quotes, emergency and same-day call-outs including evenings and weekends. Call or text 07469 042726.

## Key facts

- Business name: Kerr Electrical Services (KES)
- Electrician: Eddie, time-served, over 35 years' experience. He takes the calls and does the work himself.
- Trade: Electrician for homes and small businesses
- Based: Lenzie and Kirkintilloch, East Dunbartonshire, Scotland; serves the surrounding areas
- Phone (call, text or WhatsApp): 07469 042726 (international: +44 7469 042726)
- Email: info@kerrelectricalservices.com
- Website: https://www.kerrelectricalservices.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/KerrElectricalServices/
- Quotes: free, by phone, message, website form or a visit; usually returned within 24 hours
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 9am to 5pm, flexible where needed
- Qualifications: City & Guilds Electrical Installation (Parts 1 and 2, and C Course); ONC Electrical Engineering; HNC Electrical & Electronic Engineering; IOSH Managing Safety
- Background: Eddie has done every part of the trade, from apprentice and hands-on installation and fault finding in homes to running the electrical work on large commercial, healthcare and education projects. He still does the work himself.
- Positioning: big-company standards, small-company speed and service
- Insurance: the business is insured
- Customer-supplied fittings: yes, will fit lights, sockets and other fittings the customer has bought
- Emergency and same-day call-outs: yes, including evenings and weekends
- Small jobs welcome (a single light fitting or socket) as well as larger work

## Services

- Sockets and switches (extra sockets, USB points, dimmers)
- Ring doorbell and camera, and Hive thermostat installation
- Internal lighting (ceiling, wall and kitchen lighting; replacing old fittings)
- Outdoor lighting (garden, porch and security lights; outdoor sockets)
- Electrical testing and safety checks
- Fault finding and repairs (tripping circuits, dead sockets, loss of power)
- Full and partial rewires, new circuits, loft conversions
- General domestic electrical work and electrical work for small business premises

## Areas covered

- East Dunbartonshire: Kirkintilloch, Lenzie, Bishopbriggs, Bearsden, Milngavie
- Glasgow: Southside, West End, North Glasgow, East End, City Centre
- North Lanarkshire: Cumbernauld, Kilsyth, Airdrie, Coatbridge, Motherwell
- Falkirk: Falkirk, Larbert, Stenhousemuir, Grangemouth, Denny
- Nearby but not listed: call and ask

## Why customers choose KES

- Direct contact: you speak to Eddie and he does the job, with no call centre and no subcontractors
- Local: based in Lenzie and Kirkintilloch, with a large customer base across the surrounding areas, including Glasgow, East Dunbartonshire, North Lanarkshire and Falkirk, so he can usually get to customers quickly
- Reliable: a family business with over 35 years' experience that turns up when arranged
- Big-company standards, small-company speed and service: an electrician who has worked hands-on and run large installations, now doing the work himself for homes and small businesses
- Clear pricing: free quotes and a clear price before work starts
- Reviewed: 5-star customer reviews on Google and Facebook, including an emergency call-out on Christmas Eve to restore power

## Common questions

- How do I get a quote? Call, text or WhatsApp 07469 042726, or use the form on the website. A photo of the job helps. Quotes are free.
- Do you do emergency call-outs? Yes, including same-day, evenings and weekends. Call 07469 042726.
- When are you open? Monday to Sunday, 9am to 5pm, flexible where needed; emergencies outside those hours by phone.
- How fast will I get a quote? Usually within 24 hours.
- Are you qualified and insured? Yes: City & Guilds, HNC, over 35 years' experience, insured.
- Can I supply my own fittings? Yes.
- Do you take on small jobs? Yes.
- Do you work for small businesses? Yes, as well as homes.
- Can you fit a Ring doorbell or Hive thermostat? Yes.
